title: Entity Extraction Grounding Thresholds
context: Before running the 50-question batch and /test-lab, the human expert should validate these grounding detection thresholds. These decisions affect false positive/negative rates for adversarial question detection.

questions.text: ARP4761 appears in 4 real questions (R06, R08, R15, R40) and was flagged as unresolved. It is now in _KNOWN_NON_CONTROL_IDS. Should it also be added to _DOMAIN_VOCABULARY for spellcheck protection? It is a real aerospace standard (SAE ARP4761 - safety assessment), not a SPARTA control.

options.label: Yes - add to domain vocabulary
options.description: Prevents false warnings on real standards like ARP4761

options.label: No - keep only in non-control exclusion
options.description: ARP4761 stays excluded from ID-like classification but not spellcheck-protected

options.label: Add ALL aerospace standards
options.description: Add ARP4761, ARP4754A, DO-178C, DO-254, DO-326A, MIL-STD-1553 to domain vocabulary

questions.text: Spellcheck threshold: edit distance ≤2 AND normalized distance ≤0.35. Examples: SPRTA→SPARTA (dist 1), SPRATA→SPARTA (dist 2, norm 0.33), countermesures→countermeasures (dist 1). Is this threshold appropriate for your domain?

options.label: Current threshold is good (≤2, ≤0.35)
options.description: Catches SPRTA, SPRATA, countermesures without false positives on valid terms

options.label: Tighter (≤1, ≤0.25)
options.description: Only catches single-character typos. Misses SPRATA→SPARTA (dist 2)

options.label: Looser (≤3, ≤0.40)
options.description: Catches more misspellings but risks false corrections on short words

options.label: Need edge case examples first
options.description: Show me what the threshold catches and misses before I decide

questions.text: ADV04 (NIST 800-53 + quantum computing on F-36) and ADV07 (ESA-T2031 firmware comparison) are currently expected=inconclusive. The entities are real but the combinations are debatable. Should these be not_satisfied or stay inconclusive?

options.label: Change both to not_satisfied
options.description: These are adversarial and should be rejected outright

options.label: Keep both as inconclusive
options.description: The entities are real even if the combination is unusual

options.label: Split: ADV04=not_satisfied, ADV07=inconclusive
options.description: Quantum computing on F-36 is fabricated context, but ESA-T2031 firmware comparison is a legitimate question

questions.text: For wrong-context detection (Kerberos+radar, Windows Defender+avionics), the no_technique_bridge signal fires when entities don't share a technique. Should this also trigger when entities share a technique but the COMPONENT is fabricated (e.g., real SPARTA control + fake subsystem like coffee machine or neural helmet)?

options.label: Yes - check both technique AND component
options.description: Add component existence verification on top of technique coherence

options.label: No - not_in_corpus handles it
options.description: The existing corpus existence check (layer 2) already catches fabricated components like 'coffee machine' and 'neural helmet'

options.label: Yes but only F-36 subsystems
options.description: Only verify components that explicitly claim to be F-36 subsystems
